how_to_apply: Despite the term "Apply Online" being commonly searched, Sainik School Bijapur's recruitment process for this advertisement is offline. Candidates must follow these steps:
Download the prescribed application form from the official website, www.sssbj.in, under the notification-vacancy link.
Fill the application form completely and duly sign it.
Attach attested copies of all required documents, including educational and experience certificates.
Affix a passport-size photograph at the designated space on the form.
Enclose a self-addressed envelope affixed with postage stamps worth Rs. 55/- (for communication through Speed Post).

Enclose an A/C payee Demand Draft of Rs. 500/- (non-refundable) in favour of Principal, Sainik School Bijapur, payable at State Bank of India, Sainik School Campus Bijapur Branch (IFSC Code: SBIN0003163).

Send the complete application to: Principal, Sainik School Bijapur, Athani Road, District Vijayapura, Karnataka - 586108, so that it reaches within 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement.
important_instructions: The school will not be responsible for any postal delay or missing envelope, and no claim will be entertained in this regard. Applications received after the due date, or without the supporting documents or the prescribed application fee, will be rejected without any intimation. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the Written Test/Practical Test/Interview. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the selection test/interview or for joining the post. Employment conditions and Service Rules are in consonance with Sainik Schools Society Rules and Regulations, presently in vogue and as amended from time to time. The job is transferable within All India liability, except for the General Employee post. Selected candidates should be prepared to take on responsibilities usual to a residential (boarding) school. Vacancies mentioned in the notification may increase or decrease at the discretion of the Principal, Sainik School Bijapur. The school administration reserves the right to cancel any vacancy due to administrative or policy reasons.

Candidates with qualifications such as Post Graduation, Graduation, B.Ed., Diploma, Nursing qualifications and 10th Pass can also explore more Teaching Government Jobs, School Jobs and Government Jobs available across India.

content_sections.heading: Sainik School Bijapur Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for each post is based on educational qualification, age limit, and category-specific documentation as detailed below. Candidates should carefully check the qualification for the specific post they intend to apply for before submitting their application. Note: The notification lists several detailed qualification routes (essential and desirable) for the PGT and TGT posts, including B.Ed.-M.Ed. integrated routes and RCI B.Ed. (Special Education) routes. Candidates are advised to refer to the full official notification on www.sssbj.in for the complete, exact wording of each qualification clause before applying, as some sub-clauses are subject-specific.

rows.essential_qualification_summary: Integrated Post Graduate course from an NCTE-recognized institution/university in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks including B.Ed. component, OR Master's Degree with at least 50% marks in the subject along with a B.Ed. Degree from an NCTE-recognized institution with at least 50% marks, OR a three-year integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed. or four-year integrated degree with at least 50% marks including B.Ed. component. Desirable: experience as TGT in a recognized institution, experience of working in a school, knowledge of computer application, and working knowledge of English.

rows.post: TGT (English / Biology / Maths / Kannada / Physics / Social Science)
rows.essential_qualification_summary: Four-year integrated degree course from an NCTE-recognized institution with at least 50% marks in the concerned subject and in aggregate including B.Ed. component, OR Bachelor's/Honours Degree with at least 50% marks in the concerned subject(s) along with a B.Ed. Degree from an NCTE-recognized institution with at least 50% marks, OR a three-year integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed., OR one-year B.Ed. (Special Education) from the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) with at least 50% marks, OR Post Graduation in the concerned subject with a minimum of 55% marks along with three-year integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed. Candidates must also have qualified the Central Teachers Eligibility Test (Paper-II) conducted by CBSE and must have studied the relevant subject as an elective/main subject for the specified number of years/semesters. Subject-specific study requirements apply for each TGT post (for example, TGT Maths requires Mathematics, Physics, and one of Chemistry/Electronics/Computer Science/Statistics as per the notification; candidates with B.Sc. Hons in Physics or Chemistry are not eligible for TGT Maths). Desirable: experience of working in a school, knowledge of computer applications, and working knowledge of English (and Kannada for the TGT Kannada post).

Essential: Senior Secondary/Intermediate with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks, and a Degree or Diploma in the craft field from a recognized university/institution. Desirable: ability to teach and communicate fluently in both Hindi and English, and basic knowledge of computer applications for school-related tasks.

Three-year Diploma in General Nursing or B.Sc. in Nursing from a recognized institution with valid Registration, along with 5 years' experience or ex-servicemen of Medical Assistant trade with at least 5 years' service after training. Proficiency in Hindi and English languages is required.

10th Pass from a recognized Board. Multi-skill knowledge is preferred, such as Bakery, Plumbing, Carpentry, Horse Care, Housekeeping, and office equipment handling; experience in a Boarding School is preferred. Candidates must know Kannada, Hindi, and English, and should be physically fit.
